strapiBlog.title: Minor Hotels to Launch Several Branded Residences in the UAE
strapiBlog.short_description: Minor Hotels, a global leader in the hospitality industry, is making significant strides in the UAE's luxury real estate sector.

data.text:
Minor Hotels, a global leader in the hospitality industry, is making significant strides in the UAE's luxury real estate sector. With a reputation for excellence, the company is set to launch several branded residences under its renowned Anantara brand. These exclusive projects aim to redefine luxury living by combining world-class amenities with premium services, catering to discerning buyers and investors. 

Minor Hotels’ branded residences stand out for their commitment to excellence. Each project is meticulously designed to reflect the brand's ethos, ensuring an unparalleled living experience. By seamlessly integrating luxury, sustainability, and convenience, these developments cater to the demands of sophisticated investors and buyers. Check out the Minor Hotels’ upcoming branded residences in the UAE.

Anantara Mina Al Arab Residences, Ras Al Khaimah

Located in the serene coastal emirate of Ras Al Khaimah, Mina Al Arab Ras Al Khaimah is home to the luxurious Anantara Mina Al Arab Residences. This exceptional development promises a harmonious blend of modern luxury and natural beauty, offering residents an unparalleled living experience. With 94 lavish apartments and 20 iconic overwater villas, the project provides breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf, making it a prime destination for those seeking tranquility and sophistication.

Key highlights include:

  • Access to pristine beaches and lush mangroves.
  • Amenities such as an infinity pool, a fully equipped gym, and the signature Anantara Spa.
  • Eco-friendly design elements that align with sustainable living standards.

This project is perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat while still enjoying access to the vibrant lifestyle of the UAE.

Anantara Sharjah Resort and Residences


Anantara is also expanding its footprint in the cultural hub of Sharjah with the Anantara Sharjah Resort and Residences. Scheduled for completion by late 2027, this prestigious development will be located along Al Heerah Beach, offering breathtaking sea views and an immersive luxury experience.

Anantara Sharjah Residences will feature:

  • 110 guest rooms and 128 branded residences, including one- to four-bedroom apartments.
  • Private balconies, premium furnishings, and thoughtfully designed layouts.
  • Five distinct dining options, including the renowned Mekong restaurant.
  • Landscaped pools, beachfront access, and a family-friendly environment.

The Sharjah development perfectly caters to those who appreciate the balance of cultural heritage and modern luxury.

Anantara Santorini Abu Dhabi Retreat

Expanding into the capital, Minor Hotels introduces the Anantara Santorini Abu Dhabi Retreat, an ultra-private haven for luxury living. This exclusive development will provide an extraordinary blend of tranquility and opulence.

Key features include:

  • Luxurious villas with spacious layouts and elegant interiors.
  • A world-class wellness center offering cutting-edge treatments and therapies.
  • Gourmet dining options featuring international and local cuisine.

The Abu Dhabi retreat is designed for those seeking an exceptional boutique living experience in one of the UAE’s most prestigious locations.

Thanks to its robust economy, strategic location, and investor-friendly policies, the UAE remains one of the most attractive markets for branded residences. Minor Hotels’ decision to expand within the UAE underscores the country’s status as a global hub for luxury real estate.
